meta.title: UzMedAtlas — private clinics of Uzbekistan
meta.description: Describe your symptoms, find a matching medical specialty, and send a request to a private clinic in Uzbekistan.

home.kicker: Private clinics of Uzbekistan for international patients
home.title: What is bothering you?
home.subtitle: Describe your symptoms in your own words. We will suggest a medical specialty and matching clinics. This is not a diagnosis.
home.placeholder: For example: My knee has been hurting when I walk for several weeks.
examples: My knee hurts when I walk
home.step1: Describe the problem or skip to the catalog
home.step2: See a suggested specialty and matching clinics
home.step3: Open a clinic, review services, and send a request

checker.title: A few details to suggest the right specialty
checker.duration: How long has this been going on?
checker.disclaimer: UzMedAtlas does not make a diagnosis. We only help you choose a medical specialty and a clinic.

results.title: Based on your description, a {specialty} consultation may be a good fit.
results.empty: No published clinics were found for this specialty yet. You can still browse the full catalog.

catalog.title: Clinic catalog
catalog.subtitle: Find a private clinic by name, specialty, or service.
catalog.empty: No clinics match these filters. Try another city, specialty, or search term.

apply.title: Send a request to {clinic}
apply.subtitle: Leave your contacts and the clinic will get in touch.
apply.medicalNeed: Briefly describe the medical help you need
apply.medicalNeedPlaceholder: I would like a cardiology consultation and a heart check-up.
apply.checkerSummary: We will attach the details from the symptom checker so you do not have to repeat them.
apply.invalidPhone: Enter a phone number with a country code.
apply.emailRequired: Email is required if you prefer to be contacted by email.

success.title: Your request has been sent. The clinic will be able to contact you using the details you provided.
success.body: You can return to the catalog and look at other clinics.

footer.disclaimer: UzMedAtlas is a catalog and request form for international patients. It is not a medical information system, does not provide diagnoses, and does not replace a consultation with a doctor.
